text: The Nominating Panel - Toronto Local Appeal Body will conduct interviews and recommend four candidates to City Council for appointment to the Toronto Local Appeal Body.

The Nominating Panel - Toronto Local Appeal Body recommends that: 1. City Council appoint the following candidates to the Toronto Local Appeal Body for a term of office ending July 16, 2026, and until successors are appointed: a. Ron Kanter; b Trevor Kezwer; c. Blair Martin; and d. Paula Turtle. 2. City Council direct that Confidential Attachments 1 to 6 remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Local Appeal Body.
